caption: A dog trots along a jetty over a still lake, and its upside-down reflection trots beneath it in the water.

sa.check: A dog trots along a jetty over a still lake.
Its upside-down reflection trots beneath it in the water.
The reflection is joined to the jetty's reflection at the waterline.
The reflection blurs only where a ripple passes.

pc.expect: The reflection moves with the dog and blurs only where a ripple passes.
pc.fail: It stays still while the dog trots; or is blurred on flat water; or sharp across plain ripples.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and joined to the jetty's reflection at the waterline.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached from the jetty's reflection; or a different dog.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the dog still; or drifts across the lake.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples pass and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: One dog and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second dog appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the dog vanishes.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the jetty stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes; or the jetty changes; or the water changes colour.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes is not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
